blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Parliamentary seats have been allocated by the Commission on Elections among four winning political parties in the first Bangsamoro Parliamentary elections, with Bangsamoro Federalist Party (BFP) and United Bangsamoro Justice Party (UBJP) getting the two highest numbers of allotted seats. The Regional Board of Canvassers (RBOC) announced that the political parties secured their seats in the parliament: In the computation of the seats, the RBOC said that the BFP is allotted 16 seats, 15 seats for UBJP, eight for BGC, and one for Raayat.
